method: First whole UTC hour after each original post; a seven-day directional paper checkpoint. Long legs use price change; short legs use its negative, without leverage. This does not verify a borrow, fill, holding period or target achievement. Daily USD observations within ten minutes of each target; actual timestamps retained. Equal weight within each complete multi-token call, then equal weight across complete calls. Gross of fees, spread, slippage and funding; no leverage. Selected source set, not a complete trading record. Not wallet P&L or forecast accuracy.
